paperclip._comment: Agentic 'Paperclip function' lane (paperclip_lane.py). OPT-IN: never part of a default `all` sweep - run with `--roles paperclip --models grok-4.3,grok-4.20,grok-4.5`. Requires PAPERCLIP_API_URL + PAPERCLIP_API_KEY (board token) in env. Maps each benchmark model id -> a DEDICATED bench AGENT that runs that model; the lane creates a fixture issue assigned to that agent, triggers a fresh-session run, and scores whether it reaches a VALID disposition. SAFE-BY-DEFAULT: `agents` is empty so a stray run is a no-op (the lane skips models with no configured agent). DO NOT point this at live fleet agents - that commandeers real lanes. Provision dedicated throwaway bench Hermes agents (one per current grok model) in a sandbox/bench company, then fill `agents` + `benchCompanyId`. Candidate models to bench: grok-4.3 (reasoning, the working baseline), grok-4.20, grok-4.5. Former fast-alias TSC agents are intentionally omitted after the 2026-05-15 xAI retirement; do not model new dedicated bench agents after those retired configs.
paperclip._runtime_comment: maxWorkers=1 (SERIAL) is REQUIRED: parallel rapid-fire invokes fight the platform's GLOBAL heartbeat machinery (heartbeat.wakeup() coalesces/dedups concurrent wakeups -> 'skipped'; run-recovery reapers cancel queued runs), which company isolation can't avoid. Single-model/serial runs were clean (grok-4.3=0.94); every parallel 4-model sweep collapsed to skipped/cancelled. cellTimeoutSec=900 (raised from 600) because the grok-4.20 REASONING model legitimately runs 313-444s/cell; the lane retries transient timeouts + waits for agent-idle around each invoke. NOTE 2026-06-18: paperclip_lane SOCKET_TIMEOUT_SEC raised 45->120 — the old 45s socket timeout made a slow grok-4.20 run get abandoned mid-poll, leaving a lease-holding zombie that cascaded Errno 60 ('Operation timed out') into every following cell from ~stage 6 on. Runs in the dedicated isolated company (see _isolation_comment) so nothing acts on fixtures mid-run. ~70-90 min for the 4-model grok sweep, serial.
paperclip._isolation_comment: Bench runs in a DEDICATED ISOLATED company (Agentic Bench, e212ce50) with NO CEO/routines/active agents, so nothing in the company acts on bench fixtures mid-run (TSMC's GLaD0S + cleanup machinery was the interference that quiet-TSMC couldn't stop). reportsTo for the 4 agents = paused Bench-Manager b610338d.

scoring._comment: Per-task blend. If a task has only deterministic checks (e.g. intake ground-truth), quality = deterministic. If only judge criteria, quality = judge. If both, quality = normalized weighted blend of the two.

recommendation._comment: objective=peak_quality_cost_aware (davin's policy 2026-06-14): TIER FOR PEAK QUALITY, but don't pay multiples for marginal gains. Rule per role: start from the highest-quality model; among models within quality_epsilon (0.02) of it, prefer the lowest mean output tokens only when materially cheaper. min_success_rate_for_quality suppresses published quality/q-per-token when too few tasks succeeded; min_reps_for_decision caps under-repeated cells at candidate.

cv-review._comment: Any CV-review evaluation that proposes replacing or supplementing the deployed TSR lane must include the deployed agent+adapter+served-model baseline in the same run. A plain model-name row is not enough.

run._comment: Each model call runs in a fresh empty temp CWD with config/rules-ignore flags where the CLI supports them. reps is repetitions per role/task/model cell; decision-grade rows require recommendation.min_reps_for_decision or higher. max_workers parallelizes cells; keep modest because the Mac is shared with the live fleet + image-gen.
